hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer post detail-scroll contract smoke
hardware.tested_state: rebuilt and reflashed after ESP32 host-core consumed the shared long-event detail review scroll transcript and fallback fixture snapshots

procedure: Sourced /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/tools/idf.py, esptool.py from /Users/vincenzo/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.9_env/bin/esptool.py, and ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built firmware revision dce9736 with ESP-IDF v5.5.4; the app binary size was 0x8ea30 bytes with 0x715d0 bytes free.
Flashed the firmware to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified bootloader, app, and partition-table hashes during the ESP-IDF flash operation.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities after the flash.
expected_result: The current firmware image should still answer capability, public-key, signing-status, disabled sign_event, and malformed-frame smoke cases deterministically while preserving signing_disabled.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built clean app version dce9736 with binary size 0x8ea30 and 0x715d0 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The capability smoke passed with 40 verified exchanges, 9 response frames, and 31 expected rejection frames. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This report validates post-flash USB serial protocol behavior for the current ESP32 HEAD only.
It does not visually exercise the long-event detail-scroll transcript on the physical display.
It is not a camera test, QR flow test, key provisioning test, storage test, secure-boot test, debug-lock test, or real signing test.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, full Unicode review rendering acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or production signing readiness.
sign_event remains signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
